description: Removing a fulfilled order deletes its own and derived properties and keeps the pending orders live
code:
class Order(item, qty, price):
    this.item = item
    this.qty = qty
    this.price = price
$Order.total = $Order.qty * $Order.price
tea = Order("tea", 2, 3)
jam = Order("jam", 1, 5)
pending = Order.map(order -> order.item)
revenue = Order.map(order -> order.total).reduce((sum, total) -> sum + total, 0)
assert([pending, revenue], [["tea", "jam"], 11])
Order.remove(tea)
[pending, revenue]

description: Name.remove removes an instance that delete alone refuses while it holds properties
code:
class Sensor(name, reading):
    this.name = name
    this.reading = reading
probe = Sensor("probe", 7)
failure = ""
try:
    delete probe
catch error:
    failure = error
Sensor.remove(probe)
[failure, Sensor.length]

description: The variable named by a removed instance's id is unbound, so reading it raises a ReferenceError
code:
class Robot(name):
    this.name = name
r1 = Robot("r1")
r2 = Robot("r2")
Robot.remove(r1)
seen = ""
try:
    r1
catch error:
    seen = error
[seen, Robot.map(robot -> robot.name)]

description: A loop removes every finished task, tasks created without a name included
A helper function removes the instance it receives, which delete cannot do through a parameter
code:
class Ticket(code):
    this.code = code
t1 = Ticket("A1")
t2 = Ticket("B2")
def close(ticket) => Ticket.remove(ticket)
close(t2)
Ticket.map(ticket -> ticket.code)

description: A thrown block undoes the removal it made
code:
class Crate(weight):
    this.weight = weight
small = Crate(5)
large = Crate(20)
load = Crate.map(crate -> crate.weight).reduce((sum, weight) -> sum + weight, 0)
try:
    Crate.remove(large)
    assert(load, 5)
    throw "UNDO"
catch error:
    pass
assert([load, Crate.length], [25, 2])
Crate.remove(small)
[load, Crate.length]

description: A removal inside suppose is hypothetical
code:
class Guest(name):
    this.name = name
ana = Guest("ana")
bo = Guest("bo")
without = suppose:
    Guest.remove(ana)
    Guest.map(guest -> guest.name)
assert([without, Guest.length], [["bo"], 2])
Guest.remove(bo)
Guest.map(guest -> guest.name)

description: A subclass instance leaves through its own class with the property its parent's rule derived
code:
class Animal(name, legs):
    this.name = name
    this.legs = legs
$Animal.pairs = $Animal.legs / 2
class Bird extends Animal
robin = Bird("robin", 2)
crow = Bird("crow", 2)
dog = Animal("dog", 4)
Bird.remove(robin)
[Bird.map(bird -> bird.name), Animal.map(animal -> animal.pairs)]

description: Removing a subclass instance through its parent class raises a TypeError
code:
class Animal(name):
    this.name = name
class Bird extends Animal
robin = Bird("robin")
failure = ""
try:
    Animal.remove(robin)
catch error:
    failure = error
Bird.remove(robin)
[failure, Bird.length]
return: ["TypeError: remove expects an instance of Animal",0]

description: A value that is not an instance in the population raises a TypeError and deletes nothing
code:
class Robot(name):
    this.name = name
a = Robot("a")
failures = []
try:
    Robot.remove(null)
catch error:
    failures.push(error)
try:
    Robot.remove("a")
catch error:
    failures.push(error)
assert([Robot.length, a.name], [1, "a"])
Robot.remove(a)
[failures, Robot.length]
return: [["TypeError: remove expects an instance of Robot","TypeError: remove expects an instance of Robot"],0]

description: A standing rule removes the oldest car whenever the lot is over capacity
code:
class Car(plate):
    this.plate = plate
capacity = 2
Car("A")
Car("B")
if Car.length > capacity:
    Car.remove(Car[0])
Car("C")
Car("D")
Car.map(car -> car.plate)
